title: Equipment Relationship Discount on the Operating Lines of Credit Contract Rate
content:
A member who also finances equipment with the association through its Equipment & Vehicle Loans earns an equipment discount on the contract rate of the Operating Lines of Credit set on the AutoDraft enrolment day.

## Rule

- An equipment discount of **0.05 points** applies when the member holds an equipment loan in active or deferred status whose installments are collected by automatic payment.
- An equipment discount of **0.025 points** applies when the member holds such a loan not collected by automatic payment.
- **No** equipment discount applies when the member holds no equipment loan in active or deferred status.

The loan's status and automatic payment enrolment are read from the member's Equipment & Vehicle Loans records. The equipment discount is one of the rate discounts that are added together and capped at the product's discount cap.

## Judgement table

| Equipment loan held, by status | Installments on automatic payment | Equipment discount (points) |
|---|---|---|
| Active | Yes | 0.05 |
| Deferred | Yes | 0.05 |
| Active | No | 0.025 |
| Deferred | No | 0.025 |
| Paid off only, or none | — | None |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A member with an active New Equipment Loan on automatic payment adds 0.05 points to the line's discounts; with a Used Equipment Loan in deferred status not on automatic payment the member adds 0.025 points.
